info.title: AcqPath RSL rights preflight — public integration flow
info.description: Documented subset of the observed public API. Check declared AI input, training, indexing and search restrictions before ingestion. Quotes prepare evidence; paid delivery uses HTTP x402. Reports are not licenses or legal clearance. Rights Gateway: Preflight, bounded Ingestion Gate and signed policy revalidation. Official TS/Python signer plus AcqPath SIWX adapter required.

get.description: Read current rights.preflight.v1 availability, supported origins and fresh/deep report prices before preparing a quote. No payment.

post.description: Free conservative XML inspection. No external resource is fetched. ai-index uses the v3.1 profile; crawl remains legacy and cannot imply usage rights.

post.summary: Prepare a report before requesting payment
post.description: No financial settlement occurs. Missing declarations return available:false and charge_micro:0. UNKNOWN with a discovered declaration is disclosed before purchase.

post.summary: Check RSL and machine-readable content usage rights before AI ingestion
post.description: Use the tested official TypeScript or Python x402 signer with the AcqPath SIWX adapter; the normal signer and random payment nonce remain unchanged. Retain private X-AcqPath-Request state and retry the same normalized body. Zero-config stock x402, stock SIWX-only hooks, Agent402 automatic router execution and generic paid proxies are not claimed. Empty POST is discovery-only; never pay until a prepared binding is returned. UNKNOWN is not permission.

post.summary: Batch content usage rights evidence before RAG ingestion
post.description: Batch observed RSL rights evidence before RAG ingestion, AI input, training or indexing. One to four reviewed URLs; signed per-resource policy, provenance, conflicts and revalidation checkpoints. Fresh 0.04 + 0.02 per unique URL; deep 0.06 + 0.04. USDC on Base. AcqPath SIWX adapter required; not legal clearance. Charge buys a bounded observation attempt, including UNKNOWN or unavailable sources. No result is legal permission. Persist private operation state and retry the same operation with the official TypeScript/Python x402 signer plus AcqPath SIWX adapter.

post.description: Did this resource AI usage policy change? Revalidate one signed AcqPath checkpoint with conditional source requests; signed policy diff and license-path changes. Fresh 0.03 / deep 0.06 USDC on Base. Reviewed origins only; AcqPath SIWX adapter required. UNKNOWN is not permission.
